turns.text: Hi. The print was delivered to the old flat. I'd like to change the delivery address on that order now.
I’m sorry the print went to your old flat. Could you send me the order number (SC- followed by four digits) and the email you used to place the order? I’ll check what options are available.
Order SC-5209, email cressida.paunelu@example.com. The new delivery address would be Lindenweg 9, Graz.
I’m sorry the print went to your old flat. The delivery address can only be changed before the order ships. Since SC-5209 has already shipped, I can’t change its address to Lindenweg 9, Graz.

rule.ro: Adresa de livrare se poate schimba până la expedierea comenzii. Schimbarea trebuie aprobată de echipă.
rule.en: The delivery address can change until the order ships. Staff must approve the change.

turns.text: I do not want a return. I only want the delivery address updated after delivery.
I understand you only want to update the address, not return the print. The delivery address can only be changed before the order ships, so I can’t update it after delivery. No return was requested.
